store.tagline: Your ssh config's hosts, one Enter from a terminal
features: Every host in `~/.ssh/config` and its included files, one section per file
The address, user and port on each row, with a tag for hosts behind a jump host
`enter` opens a terminal running ssh, or runs a command you typed in the bar
`cmd+shift+c` copies the ssh command, `cmd+shift+j` the jump-host form for a machine without your config
`cmd+p` pings the host and shows the round trip

screenshots.caption: Hosts sectioned by the file they came from, user and port on the right, a jump host tagged
From the root, a host's real name finds its alias: example finds the four hosts under example.com
Connect on Enter; copy the host, the ssh command or its -J form through the jump host; ping
Ping sends one echo and shows the round trip as a toast

actions.title: Connect

actions.title: Copy ssh -J command

actions.title: Ping
actions.description: One echo to the HostName; the round trip as a toast.
